page.overview:
What is Rellim Ohcanep?

Rellim Ohcanep is a realm from Mortal Kombat, referenced in Mortal Kombat 3, Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3, and Mortal Kombat Trilogy, upon winning 100 straight matches in two player mode. This feat brings the victorious player to a black screen claiming that they are entering the realm of Rellim Ohcanep, where neither Earthrealm nor Shao Kahn claim any stake. This would then treat them to a game of [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galaga Galaga]. Rellim Ohcanep is supposedly the realm where this game takes place.

While it has not yet been a canon part of the storyline, it was stated as a realm in-game and thus should be kept in mind when including a list of all Mortal Kombat realms.
